options.nav.label: Sections
options.appearance.title: Appearance
options.languageHint: The language of this extension's screens.
options.behavior.title: Behavior
options.fastModeLong: Deletes and archives through the site's own request, which is much faster and doesn't need its menus on screen. If a request fails, the extension falls back to clicking through the page's menus, one chat at a time. Turn this off to always use the menus.
options.autoLoadLong: While you are selecting, chats that the site loads as you scroll get checkboxes automatically.
options.thresholdHint: When you delete more chats than this, you must also tick a box to confirm.
options.launcher: Show a launcher button on chat pages
options.launcherHint: A small button in the corner of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok that opens the panel. Off by default.
options.shortcut.title: Keyboard shortcut
options.shortcut.hint: Works on supported chat pages. Change it in your browser's shortcut settings.
options.privacy.title: Privacy
options.privacy.local: Everything runs on your device. The extension has no server and sends no data anywhere.
options.privacy.noAccount: No account, no analytics, no ads, no remote code.
options.privacy.permissions: It only acts on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, and only reads each site's chat list, never your conversations.
options.privacy.storage: Only your settings and a small support-reminder timer are stored, in this browser.
options.diagnosticsCopied: Diagnostics copied. Paste them into a bug report.
options.resetConfirm: Reset all settings to their defaults?
options.about.title: About
options.about.body: AI Bulk Chat Manager lets you select many chats at once on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, then delete, archive or export them. It is free and open source (MIT).
options.about.legal: Independent project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or xAI. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok are trademarks of their owners. Icons are based on Lucide (ISC licence).
